selection_decision.label_note: Native-name bases are source-backed; English regional qualifiers are explicit editorial disambiguators, not claims of a universal native self-name or shared translation.

sources.use: Factual name bases for the fourteen unchanged requested languages. Yucatec and Tajik names are menu-capitalized; comments about varieties do not override IANA scope.
Prefer precise individual-language identities when the intended variety is known; no automatic umbrella-to-child matching is claimed.
The major Huasteca Nahuatl cluster and its three registered constituent identities.
Nahuatl/Mexicano name bases and Huasteca variety distinctions.
Chanka and Collao variety distinction and writing support; quz remains Cusco only.
Qichwa name base and normalized writing.
Bolivian Qhichwa name base and writing-normalization work, page 113.
Principal Ecuadorian regional inclusion; provincial Kichwa figures are not exact qug counts. Indexed primary map checked, not full PDF.
